::: {#sol-copied-memory}

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
copied_array = pixels.copy()
copied = torch.tensor(copied_array)
copied[0, 0] = 99
copied_entry = copied[0, 0].item()
print(copied_array[0, 0], copied_entry)
```

`torch.tensor` copies the numbers,
so the array kept `r py$copied_array[1, 1]` while the [tensor](#def-tensor) changed to `r py$copied_entry`.
Sharing, as in @sol-shared-memory, saves time and memory on large data,
at the cost of a change in one place showing up in the other.

:::
